decisionsTitle: The badge watermark's size, space and place: four numbers in a fold of its own, «Logo-ul clubului (filigran)» (amending §965)
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-11-17, four days before Saturday's race (2026-11-21), designing the volunteers' badges with the watermark just released (§965):** «și practic trebuie să pot seta dimensiunea logo-ului, padding și offset» — and of the choice itself, which sat inside «Locul pentru nume»: «nu văd unde să pun logo». Amends §965, which left out «a choice of where the watermark stands or how large it is» and refused a logo rising beside «Nume:» to be larger — now the default's rule only — and the designer of §764.

**Decision.**

- **Four whole numbers in the badge's design**, each with its bounds and its default (`BADGE_FOOTER_LOGO_SETTINGS` in `badge-geometry.ts`):
  - `footerLogoSizePct` — «Mărimea logo-ului (% din lățimea ecusonului)»: 10–100, default 67. The logo's widest width is that share of the badge's paper width; its height follows the lockup's proportion (`LOGO_RATIO`). At 67 it keeps §965's room under «Nume:»; any other number is drawn as typed wherever the writing area holds it (below).
  - `footerLogoPaddingMm` — «Spațiu în jurul logo-ului (mm)»: 0–20, default 0. That many millimetres are kept clear between the logo and the edges of its room, on every side, before it is fitted: the space makes it smaller and never moves a row.
  - `footerLogoOffsetXMm` — «Deplasare stânga–dreapta (mm)» — and `footerLogoOffsetYMm` — «Deplasare sus–jos (mm)»: −100…100, default 0; positive is right and down, and the help says so («Pozitiv = mai jos»). A move never changes the size.

  Each is read forgivingly by the one reader (`readBadgeDesign`): a design saved before them, a value of the wrong type, a fraction or a number out of bounds reads as the default — never refused on read — and the designer says so beside the fold (`badgeDesignDropped`, as it does for §965's level). The save refuses a number that is not whole or not within its bounds, naming its box — every wrong box of the four at once — with every box kept; an empty box is the default, as a form from before the boxes posts none and an empty level is `off`. The preview's address carries the four, so the preview follows the unsaved boxes as they are typed; the event's file carries them under `badges.design`, the import's diff naming each, and so does a copy of the event. Saved and audited as every key of the design is (`event.badge_design_changed`, each key named).
- **The size chooses the room; the space and the moves do not.** The logo stands where §965 puts it — centred across the badge, on the foot of the writing area's lower part (the writing area's foot less half the pad) — and is fitted, less the space on every side, in the room its size chooses:
  - at **67, the default**, §965's room, from the foot of «Nume:»'s line down to that foot: as large as that room allows and never wider than two thirds of the badge, so a badge left at the defaults is §965's;
  - at **any other number**, the whole writing area — the white between the role's band, or the free-text line, and the telephone's row or the badge's foot, between the content's sides: the logo is the share typed wherever the white holds it, rising over «Nume:» as far as it must (it is drawn first, so «Nume:», the lines and the marker's area go over it), and smaller only where the white is too short or too narrow.

  Then the two offsets move it, and last it is kept inside the whole writing area less the space. So the club may put it anywhere in the white where the name is written, and never over the header, the role's band, the free-text line or the telephone's row. It still takes no height: no row moves, and `badgeRows` and the save's fit check (`badgeSizeRefusal`) are unchanged, so a size that fits without the logo fits with it at every setting. Measured on the default 90 × 35 mm strip, whose writing area is 13.3 mm tall: 67 draws §965's 21.7 × 8.9 mm under «Nume:», a quarter of the width; 10 % is 9 mm and 20 % 18 mm, under «Nume:»; 25 and 30 % are 22.5 and 27 mm, over «Nume:»; from 36 % the writing area's height stops it at 32.3 × 13.3 mm, its top on the role's band's foot. On 100 × 40 mm: 25.2 mm at 67, 30 mm at 30 %, up to 37.5 mm. On a tall badge the width decides — on 90 × 287 mm, 9 mm at 10 %, 60 mm at 67 % and the whole width between the sides, 86 mm, at 100 %. So on a short strip a number under 67 may draw a larger logo than 67 does — 67 keeps §965's room, there a quarter of the width — which the size's help line says and the fold's closed line shows. The space makes the logo smaller where its room holds it — at 67 on the default strip each millimetre takes two from the room's height: 16.8 mm wide at 1 mm, 7.1 mm at 3 mm — and where the logo stands well inside its room the space keeps it that far from the edges, shrinking it only once it reaches them.
- **No speck.** A logo its room leaves narrower than 5 mm (`BADGE_FOOTER_LOGO_MIN_WIDTH`) is not drawn, and the fold's closed line says «nu încape»: so 4 mm of space at 67 on the default strip (which left 2.3 mm) and 5 mm on 100 × 40 mm (which left a 0.9 × 0.4 mm dot in the preview) draw none. Under every box §965 draws — the narrowest, over every whole size the bounds allow and each set of rows, is 9.45 mm, on 60 × 48 mm with the free-text line and the telephone — so the defaults never meet it; and under the least size, 10 % of the narrowest badge, 6 mm.
- **One box.** `badgeFooterLogoBox` in `badge-geometry.ts` still computes it, now with the four as its `placement`, and `badgeLayout` hands it the design's own: the sheet (`badges-pdf.ts`), the picture (`badge-image.tsx`, through the preview route) and so the print panel's pictures draw the same box, and the designer names its size from the same box drawn without a badge's words (`badgeFooterLogoOf`, which reads the pad and «Nume:»'s line from the one computation `badgeLayout` writes «Nume:» by). Tested at every width and height step of 10 mm the bounds allow and the tallest, with every set of rows a club may tick, at sizes 10, 67 and 100 %, spaces 0 and 20 mm and each move at ±100 mm: inside the writing area less the space, over no band and no row, exactly as large as its size and room allow, the default size never over «Nume:» unless moved up, the rest of the layout identical; the PDF's call and the picture's markup read back into the same box.
- **At the defaults every badge is §965's, byte for byte.** 67 % is §965's two thirds: no whole percent says it exactly, so the default is read as two thirds (`badgeFooterLogoWidthShare`) and any other percent as itself; then §965's room, no space, no move, and a box the writing area never has to stop. Held by `tests/unit/volunteers/badge-type-unchanged.test.ts` and its snapshot `badge-drawing-before-logo-controls.json`, written by that test from the code before the four settings (baseline `BR-V4.56-2026-11-17`, with the taller badges): every case at each level — the layout, the picture's markup and the sheet's calls — and the box alone on every size the bounds allow in steps of 10 mm, drawn again with the four spelled out at their defaults and as stored without them. Why: a badge designed and printed before the race stays the same badge until the club moves its logo. `BADGE_DRAWING_VERSION` is 4, so every picture's address changes.
- **A fold of its own.** «Logo-ul clubului jos, ca filigran» leaves «Locul pentru nume» for a fold right after it, «Logo-ul clubului (filigran)», with the house's glyph for a picture and a closed line that says the level and, while the logo is drawn, the share of the badge's width it is drawn at — the box itself, never the number typed: «Mediu · 30%»; «Mediu · 24% (cât încape)» when its room keeps it under the size asked, as the default does on the default strip; «Mediu · nu încape» when no logo fits; «Fără» while it is off. Inside: the level's select as before, then the four native number boxes in whole steps within the bounds — the size and the space with the phone's digits keyboard, the two moves without it, since an iPhone's digits pad has no minus key and a number box alone gives it the keyboard that has one — two side by side on a computer and one under the other on a phone, each with one short help line; the size's: «Cât de lat e logo-ul, din lățimea ecusonului: urcă peste „Nume:” dacă e nevoie și se micșorează singur dacă nu încape în zona albă. La 67, cel implicit, rămâne sub „Nume:”.» They are always enabled and always posted, «Fără» included. «Locul pentru nume»'s closed line no longer names the logo.

**Not done (each its own change, when asked).** Another picture than the club's lockup (a sponsor's, the event's); the header's logo; rotating the logo; the race numbers (bibs); a size or a place per role.

**Refused.** A move that also frees the size, so that a logo moved up over «Nume:» grows there: on the default strip it would jump from 21.7 to 32.3 mm at the first millimetre and then fill the white, where the move could no longer show — the size says how large, the moves say where. A logo over a band or a row, wherever it is asked to go: their words must read. A logo narrower than 5 mm: a speck, not the club.
changelogLine: - **The badges' logo, sized and placed by the club** — on the volunteers' badges page, «Logo-ul clubului (filigran)» is a section of its own, after «Locul pentru nume», with the logo's size (% of the badge's width), the space kept around it and two moves, left–right and up–down, in millimetres; the logo always stays in the white area of the name, the preview follows as you type, and a badge left at the defaults prints exactly as before. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given «Cum arată ecusonul», then «Logo-ul clubului (filigran)» is a fold of its own right after «Locul pentru nume» — which no longer holds the logo's select nor names the logo in its closed line (amending criterion 256) — with the picture's glyph, a closed line naming the level and, while the logo is drawn, the share of the badge's width it is drawn at, read from the box the sheet and the picture draw («Mediu · 30%»; «Mediu · 24% (cât încape)» when its room keeps it under the size asked; «Mediu · nu încape» when no logo fits), and inside the level's select and four native number boxes in whole steps, always enabled: «Mărimea logo-ului (% din lățimea ecusonului)» 10–100 and «Spațiu în jurul logo-ului (mm)» 0–20 with the phone's digits keyboard, «Deplasare stânga–dreapta (mm)» and «Deplasare sus–jos (mm)» −100…100 without it, so an iPhone offers a minus sign — each with one help line, in Romanian and English; the preview follows the unsaved boxes (2026-11-17, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: unit `volunteers/badges-page-render.test.ts`, `volunteers/badge-footer-logo-controls.test.ts`.

Given «Salvează ecusonul», then the four numbers are kept in `events.badge_design` as `footerLogoSizePct` (default 67), `footerLogoPaddingMm` (default 0), `footerLogoOffsetXMm` and `footerLogoOffsetYMm` (default 0), each key changed audited by name; a number that is not whole or not within its bounds is refused naming its box — every wrong box at once — with every box kept, and an empty box is the default; a design stored or an event file made before them, a value of the wrong type and a number out of bounds read as the default, named beside the fold and never a throw; the four travel in the event's file under `badges.design`, the diff naming each, and in a copy of the event (2026-11-17, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: unit `volunteers/badge-footer-logo-controls.test.ts`, integration `volunteers/badges.test.ts`.

Given a badge design with a level chosen, then the club's lockup is never wider than the size's share of the badge's width (67 % being two thirds) and is fitted, less the space on every side, at 67 in the writing area's lower part under «Nume:»'s line and at any other size in the whole writing area — rising over «Nume:» if it must, so that on the default 90 × 35 mm strip it is 21.7 mm wide at 67, 27 mm at 30 % and 32.3 mm from 36 % — and is not drawn when that leaves it narrower than 5 mm; it is moved by the offsets with right and down positive, a move never changing its size, and kept inside the whole writing area less the space — never over the header, the role's band, the free-text line or the telephone's row — at every size the bounds allow, with every set of rows, at sizes 10, 67 and 100 %, spaces 0 and 20 mm and moves of ±100 mm; no row moves, the save answers every size as it does without the logo, and the PDF sheet, the picture, the print panel's pictures and the designer's closed line read the same box (2026-11-17, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: unit `volunteers/badge-footer-logo-controls.test.ts`.

Given a badge design whose four numbers are at their defaults — spelled out, or absent from a design stored before them — then every badge prints exactly what it printed before them at every level: the same layout, the same picture and the same calls to the PDF; the drawing's version is 4, so every picture's address changes (2026-11-17, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: unit `volunteers/badge-type-unchanged.test.ts`.

batchLine: the badges' watermark sized and placed by the club, in a fold of its own
